title: UAS activity over Wright-Patterson

tellings.quote: Med flight at patteron Tower use Extreme Caution for heavy uas uh movement on the base

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, plays audio that he says comes from the control tower at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio in 2024. On it, the tower warns a medical flight to use extreme caution because of heavy UAS movement on the base. UAS means unmanned aircraft, such as drones. He tells it as a sign that unknown craft were moving over a major military base.
